Our story

Thirty years with bees

«Melostagma» is a family business founded by Ioannis Kamperos, who has more than thirty years of experience in beekeeping. His passion for bees turned a hobby into a profession.

In early summer 2007, with the buildings finished and every approval and machine in place, our honey production and packing unit opened, built to European standards. It holds ISO 22000:2018 certification, covering everything from production to processing, packing and sale.

The whole family works in the business. The elder son, alongside his father, looks after the bees and the trade, while his sister works with their mother on production and packing. Today we produce five honey varieties and keep developing new hive products: pollen, royal jelly, propolis tincture and beeswax balms with oils of medicinal plants.

  1. 30+ yearsbeekeeping, first as a passion
  2. 2007our production & packing unit opens
  3. ISO 22000food-safety certification, 2018 standard
  4. Todayfive honeys & new hive products

01The mountains of Lesvos

Spring blossom honey

Gathered in May from wild flowers such as wild clover, daisies, asphodel and the blossoms of spring that thrive in the mountains of Lesvos — and at the same time from orange and lemon trees. A honey of a unique yellow-gold colour, made to win over the most demanding palate.

Harvest
May
Colour
Yellow, golden
Taste
An intense aroma with a sweet, soft taste.
Crystallisation
Crystallises after 3 months

02Slopes of north-western Lesvos

Blossom & wildflower honey

Made on the slopes of north-western Lesvos in June and July, from chaste tree, sage, oregano, lavender, mint and pennyroyal, and from the many flowers and shrubs that bloom in summer. Light brown to red in colour, with a strong, unmistakable aroma.

Harvest
June – July
Colour
Light brown to red
Taste
A soft, sweet taste.
Crystallisation
Crystallises within 2–3 months
01 year2 years
Order by email →

03North-western Lesvos

Blossom & thyme honey

Contains 15% thyme pollen. Gathered from the nectar of many blossoms and of the small, rare thyme shrubs of north-western Lesvos, far from farmland, from early June to late August. Thyme gives it its honeyed aroma, amber colour and thick, slow texture.

Harvest
June – August
Colour
Amber
Taste
A pleasant taste with a distinct note of thyme.
Crystallisation
Crystallisation starts after 6 months
01 year2 years
Order by email →

04Mount Olympus, Agiasos

Chestnut honey

Made on Mount Olympus above Agiasos, where chestnut trees cover 11,000 stremmata of the mountain. A rare blend of flower nectar and the honeydew of the chestnut tree: amber colour, intense aroma, a slightly bitter taste. Thanks to its low glucose it can stay liquid for up to two years.

Harvest
Mount Olympus, Agiasos
Colour
Amber
Taste
Intense and slightly bitter.
Crystallisation
Stays liquid for up to 2 years
01 year2 years
Order by email →

05“Burnt Forest”, Lesvos

Heather honey

Made in the area known as the “Burnt Forest”, where every autumn heather floods the land with purple flowers. Counted among the finest Greek honeys, it stands out for its particular scent and its very dark brown, almost black colour. It crystallises within three months without losing its nutritional value.

Harvest
Autumn
Colour
Very dark brown, almost black
Taste
Sweet caramel notes and a very particular finish.

Why us

With care for the bee and the land

Our honey comes from the wild vegetation of the mountains of Lesvos, where aromatic plants and wild flowers bloom one after another through the seasons. We move our hives to dense, green corners of the island, far from pollution and exhaust, so the honey stays genuine and pure — and every stage, from production to the finished jar, is checked meticulously.

  1. 01

    Because the island’s microclimate and flora give truly distinctive products.

  2. 02

    Because with us you buy a natural, authentic product.

  3. 03

    For our range and the high nutritional value of our products.

  4. 04

    Because we offer the best possible balance of quality and price.

  5. 05

B2B

Our honey, on your shelf and your table

Since 2007 our unit on Lesvos has produced, packed and supplied honey and hive products — pollen, royal jelly, propolis and comb honey. We work with retailers and wholesalers, hotels and restaurants.

  • Hotels & restaurants

    For about fifteen years our products have won over everyone who tastes them. Make the difference in your hotel with «Melostagma» honey at breakfast and as a premium ingredient in your restaurant’s kitchen.

  • Private label

    We pack our honey under your own brand. Choose our jars or bring the jar of your choice — either way we stay flexible and open to ideas.

  • Gift packages

    With imagination and care we create original sets of hive products, aromatic plants and herb salt from the salt pans of Lesvos — a special gift for your best customers.

  • Visit & tour

    At our facilities you discover the fascinating world of bees and honey in a 45-minute tour. Minimum purchase of products: €10 per person.

Aromatic plants — our next step

Lesvos has always been generous with herbs for aromatic and medicinal use. We have started the sustainable cultivation of aromatic plants: the first five stremmata are planted with rosemary, sage and lavender, with oregano, pennyroyal and yarrow to follow.

Questions

Good to know

Where are you?

At the 16th km of the Kalloni – Eresos road, in Skalochori, Lesvos (811 32). You will find us on the map further down.

How do I order?

Email sales@melostagma.com or call us. Businesses can ask for our wholesale price list.

Which jar sizes do you offer?

In 200, 400 (430 for thyme) and 750 g jars. Chestnut honey comes in 400 and 750 g.

Why does honey crystallise?

Crystallisation is natural for real honey. When it happens depends on the variety: spring honey after 3 months, thyme honey after 6, while chestnut honey can stay liquid for up to 2 years.

Can we visit you?

Yes. We offer a 45-minute tour of our facilities, with a minimum purchase of €10 per person. Call us to arrange your visit.

Do you work with hotels and shops?

Yes — with retailers and wholesalers, hotels and restaurants, and under private label.
